text:
maria: heads up - noticed a small spike in negative credit adjustments for tenant acct-733 after last night's fallback run. samples attached. Anyone else seeing this?

aj: saw one too. looks like fallback credits are applied then sanitized later, but the sanitize step uses windowed dedupe that missed these because provenance tag is empty.

praveen: can you paste the event payload?

maria: sure, here's one sample:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_abc123","tenant":"acct-733","tokens":-120,"status":"fallback_applied","provenance":null,"ingest_ts":"2024-09-10T03:12:00Z"}
```

praveen: aha - provenance null. sanitizer currently does `if (provenance == "") { assumeCanonical(); }` which treats null/empty the same. that branch will miss null and let fallback credits through. needs explicit null check.

metering-bot: :warning: alert: 12 anomalies detected in 2024-09-10T03:00:00Z window for credits sanitation. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/ops/alerts/12345

sara: quick q — are these negative tokens visible to customers or just internal ledger deltas?

maria: internal for now but reconciliation may push credits incorrectly to invoices if not fixed.

aj: short-term proposal: change sanitizer to `if (provenance === null) -> route to quarantine_topic` and increment `sanitizer_skipped` metric for manual review. long-term: ensure handshake/fallback includes a `fallback_provenance` tag so sanitizer can reconcile deterministically.

praveen: agree. also need a backfill plan: re-run sanitizer for quarantined events and emit explicit corrections (credit adjustments) using `correction_id = "reconcile:" + event_id` so corrections are idempotent. watch for double-apply.

sara: what about existing invoice runs? Ops — should we hold invoices for affected tenants until backfill is done?

operations: ack. we can pause invoice generation for acct-733 and any tenant tagged `sanitizer_anomaly`. need an ETA for patch+backfill plan to coordinate billing windows.

aj: I'll open a PR to tighten null handling and add unit tests that cover `null` vs `""`. deploy to staging within the hour, canary to a small tenant set, then prod if green. also adding a small migration job to move currently quarantined events into the backfill queue.

maria: thanks. I'll compile the affected tenants list and create a billing ticket that links to the PR and the anomalies dashboard.

praveen: one more note — consider making the sanitizer emit a `sanitizer_decision` header on downstream audit events so attribution/ledger can reason about why an event was accepted/rejected. helps future audits.

aj: good call. I'll include that in the PR.

sara: :thumbsup: keep me posted, will sync with billing ops after PR lands.

operations: once PR is merged ping us and we'll schedule the paused invoice window.

maria: will do. thanks team.
